reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 10(a) is a Vendor-side (Kubient) defend/indemnify/hold-harmless obligation in Customer's favour covering third-party Claims arising out of the Services, the Auction Platform, Kubient's breach of any representation or warranty, and Kubient's/its subcontractors' acts or omissions.

IP infringement is reached both by the broad 'arising out of or in connection with the Services / Auction Platform' prongs and by the breach-of-warranty prong feeding off the express non-infringement warranty at Section 9(b)(i) (p0033); the failed 'vendor indemnity for IP infringement present' regex is a phrasing artefact (no literal 'infringe' wording inside Section 10) rather than a substantive gap.

Standard indemnity procedure exists (Section 11, p0053) and the consequential-damages limitation expressly carves out indemnification liability (p0027), so Vendor's indemnity is not sub-capped — at or better than the preferred position.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and none is required; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

Minor residual: the reciprocal Customer indemnity in Section 10(b) was not quoted, so its breadth relative to the preferred 'Customer content / Customer breach of law' limit cannot be independently confirmed; this does not undermine the Vendor-indemnity compliance conclusion but should be spot-checked.
